name: encrypt
description: AES-GCM content encryption. Pages with a password param show a decryption modal instead of content. Decryption happens in-browser with zero server involvement.

config.note: Password can also be set at site-level via params.password for a site-wide lock.

params.description: Password to encrypt this page. When set, content is AES-GCM encrypted and replaced by a decryption modal.
params.effect: Shows encrypt modal instead of page content. User must enter correct password to decrypt.

config.example_frontmatter:
---
title: Secret Page
password: my-secret-password
---

This content will be encrypted.

css.note: Override this file to restyle the modal (colors, fonts, border-radius, etc.)

locked.reason: decrypt.js reads these IDs/data-attrs to locate elements and read encrypted data

partials.note: Can freely change how encrypted vs plain content is wrapped
Can change visual layout, but must keep ALL locked html_ids
